csv_project_name: Consultnat for Pasadena Building & Fire Plan Review Services
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Pasadena Planning & Community Development Department, Building and Safety Division is seeking the services of qualified professional consulting firms to submit proposals to provide on-call plan review and supplemental services for public and private projects. The Consulting firm must show substantial knowledge and experience in plan review verifying compliance with the California Building Standards Code, California Fire Code, Pasadena Municipal Code, and other related codes and ordinances applicable to development projects in the City of Pasadena. The successful consultant will be dependable, cost-effective, and have expertise in building construction and building and fire codes, high quality plan review services, and the ability to meet expected plan review turnaround times. As services are requested the selected Consultant will be notified that development project plans are awaiting plan review. The selected Consultant will be required to pick-up the plans within 24 hours of notification by the City or receive plans electronically. The selected consultant must have capabilities to accept and perform electronic plan checks and receive plans electronically.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Inspection Services, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
